narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [pricing.js:39-43](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the original amount instead of the discounted one.

```
tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate)   // wrong
tax = roundCents(discounted * taxRate)   // fixed
```

Only showed up on rows with both a discount and a tax rate, which is why most cases passed anyway.
